headlines.headline: SENSEX, NIFTY50 post best day in 6 months after Finance Minister says keen on hearing views on LTCG tax
headlines.summary: Speaking at the Bloomberg event in New Delhi, Sitharaman said that debate also involves the securities transaction tax (STT) and whether different asset classes should be treated similarly.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50 above 22,500, SENSEX jumps 592 pts in noon deals; HUL, HCLTech, Bandhan Bank among buzzing stocks
headlines.summary: Shares of Puravankara jumped after the firm reported a 62% annual growth in its sales bookings in the September quarter on better demand for its residential properties.

headlines.headline: Vedanta, TCS dividend record date on October 14: Last opportunity to buy for payout
headlines.summary: Domestic stock markets follow a T+1 (trade day plus one day) settlement cycle, meaning that shares settle a business day after the trade date. Hence, the stock with the dividend record date of October 14 needs to be purchased today to be eligible for the payout.

headlines.headline: HCLTech zooms 8%, TCS, Infosys rally too; Nifty IT jumps 5%: What’s driving IT stocks higher?
headlines.summary: Analysts were divided on HCLTech following its results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. While some highlighted resilient services growth, strong margins, AI revenue momentum and a recovery in deal bookings, others flagged slowing organic growth, weakness in the software business and premium valuations.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50, SENSEX rise after weak open as investors focus on mixed global cues; HCL Tech, TCS, other IT stocks lead gainers
headlines.summary: After opening on a flat note, the NIFTY50 and SENSEX gained with key support from the heavyweight IT stocks as investors react to HCL Tech's Q2 earnings report on Tuesday, October 13.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, October 12: Apollo Hospitals, ITC fall 3%; Dr. Reddy’s, Bajaj Auto jump 3%
headlines.summary: On October 12, the SENSEX dropped by 547.65 points or 0.76% to close at 71,924.68, while the NIFTY50 ended at 22,363.35, down by 157.10 points or 0.70%.

headlines.headline: Market Wrap, Oct 12: SENSEX falls 548 pts, NIFTY50 ends at 22,363 as crude prices rise; NIFTY Smallcap 100 outshines
headlines.summary: The banking stocks declined on Monday, dragging down the sectoral benchmark index as investors focused on the latest updates from the central bank.

headlines.headline: SBI, ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, others drag Nifty Bank down 1%; here’s why banking stocks are falling today
headlines.summary: Banking stocks like SBI, ICICI Bank, among others declined on October 12, as investors focused on the latest liquidity curbing measures announced by the Reserve Bank of India.

headlines.headline: TCS, Vedanta interim dividends: Record dates this week; upcoming rights issue and other corporate actions
headlines.summary: Vedanta's board had cleared an interim dividend of ₹5 per equity share on a face value of ₹1 per equity share for FY27, amounting to nearly ₹1,955 crore.

headlines.headline: Infosys says US PERM suspension to have no material impact; IT stocks in focus
headlines.summary: In the regulatory filing, Infosys further added that it has invested in building a strong local workforce and technology and innovation hubs in the United States.

headlines.headline: Upcoming Q2 FY27 results this week: HCLTech, Nestle, Wipro, BHEL, Tech Mahindra, HDFC Bank, and more; check list
headlines.summary: Banks like HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Yes Bank, Karur Vysya Bank, South Indian Bank, Canara Bank and more will declare their results for Q2 FY27 this week.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, October 9: Apollo Hospitals jumps 5%, ITC rallies 4%, BSE falls over 1%; check list
headlines.summary: On October 9, the SENSEX advanced by 879.09 points or 1.23% to close at 72,472.33, while the NIFTY50 ended higher by 288.65 points or 1.30% at 22,520.45.

headlines.headline: Accenture shares soar 70% in three months, while TCS remains flat: Decoding the IT divergence
headlines.summary: TCS and Accenture are two of the top two global IT giants, operating in similar verticals. While Accenture shares have witnessed a sharp rebound from lower levels, the Indian peer continues to face selling pressure.

headlines.headline: Market wrap, Oct 9: SENSEX jumps 879 pts, NIFTY50 ends above 22,500 as IT stocks rally; Apollo Hospitals top gainer
headlines.summary: The broader market also closed the session positive, with the Nifty Midcap 100 rising 1.56% to settle at 58,787.30, while the Nifty Smallcap 100 rose 0.54% to end at the 19,153.70 level.

headlines.headline: Maruti Suzuki, Reliance Industries, Bharti Airtel and others: 17 NIFTY50 stocks that are near their 52-week lows; check full list
headlines.summary: On a year-on-year basis, the NIFTY50 index has, however, declined 10.5%, while NIFTY Midcap 100 and NIFTY Smallcap 100 have gained 0.6% and 6.6%, respectively.
